en: A monochrome postcard showing a long wooden school building on a wide dirt street. The structure has many tall, evenly spaced windows, a pitched roof with several chimneys, and simple classical detailing. In the foreground, a group of children in early 20th‑century rural clothing stand and walk along the street. At the top of the card are printed captions naming the city and the school.
